timeline.speaker: Peter
timeline.text: Serverless means no servers to secure, right?

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: No servers to patch. But functions, events, and roles to secure. The risk moves, not disappears.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Over-permissioned functions. A resize function that can delete any bucket.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Functions eat events from queues and storage. Treat every event as hostile and validate it.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: They're bundled into every function. Scan them or ship known vulnerabilities.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Least privilege per function. A function only touches what it needs, nothing else.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Never in environment literals. Use a managed secret store.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Enable logging and tracing on every function. Invisible functions can't be investigated.

timeline.speaker: Stewie
timeline.text: Single-purpose functions with narrow scope. That's the whole security model.
